variables.X: actual current scene, task, views and common tool evidence
variables.D: public proposed decision record generated by model

main_comparison.conditioned: L_D(D|X)+L_A(A|X,D); deployment action from X and its own sampled D

unannotated_units: Retain the existing declared route; fourteen units have no D target. Do not synthesize labels or use scoring annotations to route inference.
same_information: Teacher D is a supervision signal; model-generated D is not an additional environment observation. Both arms receive the same sourced principles and current scene.
theory: Conditional likelihood does not imply lower downstream scene error. A change in the decoded action under D interventions establishes sensitivity, not correctness. Full trajectory utility must be measured after real tool execution.
nearest_overlap: Scene-Designer already supplies OTA, so adding a reason before action is not a new three-dimensional mechanism. Distilling Step-by-Step motivates the auxiliary-supervision comparison.
potential_contribution_requires: Repeated gains in applying spatial requirements on source/template-separated complete rooms, beyond same-knowledge direct action, ordinary rule/search and feedback controls. Must include construction/repair as well as termination.
